strategy: For a group of 12 to 16, contact restaurants 4–8 weeks ahead and ask about private-dining or large-party options. Policies, rooms, and minimums change often — confirm current details directly with the restaurant before you lock in the night.

plays.title: One serious reserved dinner
plays.body: Pick a single anchor night and book it early. Call the restaurant directly, give the honest size of your group, and ask what they can do for large-party seating or private dining — then build the rest of the weekend around that one reservation.

venues.name: Parc
venues.note: The classic French bistro facing the Square, one minute away — inquire about large-party seating when you call.

venues.name: Vernick Food & Drink
venues.note: A serious New American reservation three minutes from Pine Street — inquire early about options for a bigger table.

venues.name: Via Locusta
venues.note: Handmade pasta four minutes away near the Square — ask what they can offer a larger group.

plays.title: The splinter plan
plays.body: Sixteen people rarely want the same dinner. Split into tables of four to six — casual spots within a few blocks handle that size without weeks of notice — then use the roof deck back at the house as the regroup point for a nightcap.

venues.name: Dizengoff
venues.note: Hummus bowls and fast counter service four minutes away — built for a low-lift table.

venues.name: JJ Thai Cuisine
venues.note: Reliable Thai BYOB six minutes away for the group that wants something casual.

venues.name: Good Dog Bar
venues.note: A neighborhood gastropub with a known burger and multiple floors, five minutes away.

venues.name: Friday Saturday Sunday
venues.note: A compact, high-demand dining room five minutes away — suited to a smaller splinter table.

plays.title: Dinner at the house
plays.body: The dining room seats all sixteen at one table, and two full kitchens keep the cooking from crowding the conversation. Provision from the neighborhood, or bring in help — the kitchens support a hired cook. Grocery delivery works too; coordinate timing with your host.

venues.name: Di Bruno Bros
venues.note: Cheese, charcuterie, prepared foods, and pantry supplies four minutes away.

venues.name: Trader Joe's
venues.note: Budget-friendly staples at 2121 Market Street, about eight minutes away.

venues.name: Rittenhouse Market
venues.note: Neighborhood grocery basics two minutes from the house.
